name: copyparty
description: File server with resumable uploads, WebDAV, search and a media player

paths.name: Cfg
paths.description: copyparty.conf (accounts, folders and settings), the search index and thumbnails (hist) and this install's password (.icestore-password). Keep it private.

paths.name: W
paths.description: The files copyparty shares: your whole MOS storage (/DATA).

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: copyparty web page and WebDAV, published on host as 6809

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: COPYPARTY_USER
variables.description: The admin user name written to copyparty.conf on first start. The password is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Later changes go in copyparty.conf.
